title: ‘Earliest known,’ $4 million kiddush cup bound for Ohio museum
snippet: Nov 3, 2025 · The Toledo Museum of Art in Ohio acquired what Sotheby’s calls the earliest known kiddush cup, after the auction house sold the object, which set a record for ritual Judaica, for $4 million on Oct. 29.
